scope: Tenant and operator pages with Studio-like nested workspaces, live previews, workflow centers, feature controls, report-card builders, and setup/launch previews. Final pass reconciled live templates against var/design-previews/tenant-studio-100x-workmode-rework.html.

screen_real_estate_pass.finding: Bootstrap max-width constraints were already removed; remaining waste came from rail and sidecar width ceilings.
changes: Studio shell gutter and right rail ceiling tightened so the canvas receives more width.
Studio work-mode rail and context widths narrowed across Experience, Automation, Outputs, Launch, and Control.
Studio cockpit co-pilot rail changed from fixed 320px to responsive clamp and gap tightened.
Report Card Builder and Feature Control shared command rails narrowed while preserving sticky sidecars.
Workflow Center side rail narrowed and workflow card minimum width reduced for denser wide-screen rows.
Legacy caps were removed from additional Studio-adjacent tenant command pages: School Studio, lifecycle command center, fast path, and provisioning status.
Analytics/report workspaces were converted from container-lg to full-width command workspace surfaces.
Named evidence/report surfaces now override the old --rmc-report-measure cap while focused personal/account forms remain intentionally narrow.
Fast-path, launch-lane, and provisioning timelines now form responsive wide-screen grids; governed report output receives taller preview space.

Tenant/operator headers now use a three-zone tenant contract, a roughly 25% narrower tenant search field, same-line tenant More control, and matching compact More pill treatment on /super/ and /admin/ operator surfaces.

surfaces.closure: Shared horizontal mode strip, compact 100X command header, and denser workspace contract
Command workbench with bounded preview, scrollable builder rail, and preview/publish sidecar
Command contract with persistent impact/rollout sidecar and wired sidecar preview action
Main workbench plus status/navigation side panel; duplicate hero actions and context removed
Explicit command-workspace markers and inherited base CSS
Compact embed grid and command-workspace markers
Scoped base command contract loaded tenant-wide for marked surfaces
48-62rem caps replaced with command-workspace markers and responsive wide-screen grids
container-lg caps replaced with full-width command workspace surfaces and a taller report output canvas
Named cp-evidence-page surfaces override the old report-measure cap while focused forms remain narrow
Tenant header rebalanced to brand / centered nav / compact search-actions zones; tenant search reduced about 25%; tenant, super, and admin More controls share the same compact pill grammar

remaining_risk: Authenticated browser route pass still needed in deployment or a local environment with a normally responding HTTP server; no product API or business logic changed.
